items.name: Quarterstaff
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 17, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 142
StatisticsDamage 1d4/1d4 (small), 1d6/1d6 (medium); Critical x2; Range -; Type B
Weapon Groups Double; Monk
DescriptionA quarterstaff is a simple piece of wood, about 5 feet in length. In battle, it's held with one hand at the butt and the other a quarter of the way up the staff, allowing it to block blows and make quick strikes.

items.name: +1 Studded Leather Armor
items.description: An improved form of leather armor, studded leather armor is covered with dozens of metal protuberances. While these rounded studs offer little defense individually, in the numbers they are arrayed in upon such armor, they help catch lethal edges and channel them away from vital spots. The rigidity caused by the additional metal does, however, result in less mobility than is afforded by a suit of normal leather armor.

items.name: Torch
items.description:
Price 1 cp; Weight 1 lb.

A torch burns for 1 hour, shedding normal light in a 20-foot radius and increasing the light level by one step for an additional 20 feet beyond that area (darkness becomes dim light and dim light becomes normal light). A torch does not increase the light level in normal light or bright light. If a torch is used in combat, treat it as a one-handed improvised weapon that deals bludgeoning damage equal to that of a gauntlet of its size, plus 1 point of fire damage.

items.name: Heart of the Forest
items.description:
Petrified roots of a long extinct type of willow tree form the band of this ancient ring. Within the coils it holds a nameless stone.
Wearing this ring grants several abilities
All wearers:
The ring grants a natural armor bonus, and the wearers skin becomes course to the touch, resistant to fire and cold, and alters hue at will. Providing the following spell effects:
Resist Energy 10 vs Fire & Cold
Blend at-will (+4 stealth)
Non-druids:
Beast Shape I 1x per day per con mod.
For druids:
Increases

items.name: Ring of Protection +1
items.description: This ring offers continual magical protection in the form of a deflection bonus of +1 to +5 to AC.

items.name: Clamdrinc
items.description: Introducing the peculiar elixir that combines the unlikeliest of flavors, Clamdrinc! Drawing inspiration from the iconic elven weapon wielded against the Orcs, this unique soda delivers a briny surprise with every sip. Imagine the essence of the sea captured in a fizzy concoction, where the salty undertones dance alongside a subtle hint of clam, creating an unforgettable taste adventure.
